QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Strange Dream
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra had a strange dream. Go hear what it was about.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra had a dream about the #bGolden Pig#k, and thinks something good is going happen. You asked her where the dream took place, and Cassandra gave you directions.\nShe told you that you might just find the #bGolden Pig#k if you search hard enough. The legends say that the Golden Pig brings good luck, so she wants you to try catching one.

0.0: #b#h0##k! I had the strangest dream last night! The #bGolden Pig#k appeared, and showered me with fortune! Should I go buy a lottery ticket or something?\nI was running all over to catch the Golden Pig...I was somewhere in Maple World, but I forget where. In the end, I did catch the #bGolden Pig#k, but I woke up right after.
0.1: You know...maybe this means something! I feel like that #bGolden Pig#k is running around somewhere in Maple World right now. You should try to find it!

yes.0: Okay, legends say that catching a Golden Pig will bring you good luck. Go catch a Golden Pig and let me know whether that's true, okay?\nBut you must catch a Golden Pig that's in your level range, okay? The ones that are 11 or more levels lower or 21 or more levels higher won't work!

no.0: What, you don't believe me? Does a Golden Pig sound too ridiculous to you? After everything you've seen?

1.0: You really found the #bGolden Pig#k, huh? So, what happened? Were you blessed with fantastic fortune?\r\n#L0##bUmm... Maybe? Nothing happened yet...#l\n#k
1.1: Oh...okay. Well, something good just might happen later! Thanks for letting me know. You deserve a gift for your trouble, so pick one.

yes.0: I want to catch a Golden Pig too, but I'm so busy with...stuff. I guess I'll just look for them in my dreams.
